# اُسْتُفْعِلَا (ustufʕilā) /us.tuf.ʕi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
# اِسْتَفْعِلَا (istafʕilā) /is.taf.ʕi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
